title: Berlin Wall Map Overlay: Quick Summary
items: **An overlay puts the 1989 border line on top of the present-day city** so you can read any spot in seconds.
**A good overlay tells you three things:** which side a point was on, how far it sat from the fortification, and whether it counts as on the Wall itself.
**Tap your location, read the side, check the distance to the line.** A point 400 metres away felt normal; a point 20 metres away lived with a wall at the end of the street.
**Anything within 25 metres of the line reads as on the Wall itself,** because at that range the boundary and the real fortification overlap.
**There is no Berlin Wall Street View** because the Wall is gone in almost every central spot; the overlay tells you where to point your own eyes instead.
**My move: check your hotel before you arrive.** If it comes back West, your daily walk into the centre crosses a border that did not exist for 28 years.
